organization_note: Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology (北京智谱华章科技股份有限公司), which its site calls Beijing Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited and gives an address in Haidian District, Beijing, develops the GLM models and operates the Zhipu AI Open Platform (BigModel) in China, while the international Z.ai Model API is contracted through JINGSHENG HENGXING TECHNOLOGY PTE.LTD under terms governed by Singapore law. The catalog uses the brand and both entity names, so all three belong to this record.
